# Membrane Opus plugin v0.20.8 - Table of Contents

> Membrane Opus encoder and decoder

## Pages

- [Membrane Opus plugin](https://membrane-opus-plugin.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)
- [LICENSE](https://membrane-opus-plugin.hexdocs.pm/license.md)

## Modules

- [Membrane.Opus.Decoder](https://membrane-opus-plugin.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.Opus.Decoder.md): This element performs decoding of Opus audio.
- [Membrane.Opus.Encoder](https://membrane-opus-plugin.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.Opus.Encoder.md): This element performs encoding of Opus audio into a raw stream. You'll need to parse the stream and then package it into a container in order to use it.
- [Membrane.Opus.Parser](https://membrane-opus-plugin.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.Opus.Parser.md): Parses a raw incoming Opus stream and adds stream_format information, as well as metadata.
